name: Cardeñosa de Volpejera (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cardeñosa de Volpejera (a fox, a leaf and a key on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Cardeñosa de Volpejera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cardeñosa de Volpejera arms — fox, leaf and key on white and red
